external_boundaries.name: compiler
external_boundaries.contract: Rust 1.99.1 with rustfmt/clippy; Linux validated; C compiler for bundled SQLite

external_boundaries.name: oracle
external_boundaries.contract: Exact files/runtime from rust/oracle-manifest.json; GOA2_ORACLE_SOURCE admits a source archive without original Git history

external_boundaries.name: full parity payloads
external_boundaries.contract: Canonical 6592/live 17347 plus full-game indexes; full preflight must fail on missing/changed data; artifact hosting unresolved

external_boundaries.name: runtime game pack
external_boundaries.contract: version 1 with exact oracle/source identity; externally acquired pack requires independent SHA256; public redistribution unresolved

external_boundaries.name: hosted draft verification
external_boundaries.contract: Python service and explicitly compatible frontend; optional external integration, unavailable in native-only extraction

external_boundaries.name: compatible Python service
external_boundaries.contract: Optional hosted-draft/replay-share verifiers and override metadata exporter require the matching Python backend service sources and its uv.lock environment, including FastAPI/httpx. These are not native runtime dependencies and must not be silently replaced with an incompatible frozen oracle service.

external_boundaries.name: optional Layout Lab import/evaluator
external_boundaries.contract: port_lab_situations.py --lab/--python-src and rollout_parity.py --lab-evaluator explicitly accept external tooling. The Lab backend/state_model modules and evaluator file are excluded, optional and never required or auto-discovered for ordinary native builds/tests. No Lab service is started.

external_boundaries.name: benchmark/profile artifacts
external_boundaries.contract: Full complete-game inputs come from the admitted external fixture cache; arena profiles/starts and perf.data are explicit local inputs. They are separately owned in rust/benchmarks/inputs.json; absence must not become a reduced successful run.
